name: Sqrxz
author: Retroguru
description_short: A demanding platform puzzle game built around fast reflexes and precise movement.
description_long: Guide Sqrxz through 16 challenging levels, collecting every item to unlock each exit while avoiding creatures and hazards. This remake includes classic and deluxe graphics, 18 chiptunes, a top-ten high-score table, unlimited continues, and a hidden easter egg.
